name: internal_turbulent_nusselt
title: Internal turbulent convection: Nusselt-number correlations for pipe flow (function library)
summary: Twenty-three EES FUNCTIONs returning the Nusselt number of single-phase turbulent flow in a circular pipe: Dittus-Boelter (heating/cooling, original and revised coefficients), Sieder-Tate, Hausen (turbulent thermal entry), Colburn, Drexel-McAdams, von Karman, Prandtl, Friend-Metzner, Petukhov-Kirillov-Popov, Webb, Sandall, Gnielinski (general and the two smooth-pipe forms), Churchill-Zajic, ESDU, Martinelli, Nunner, Dipprey-Sabersky, Gowen-Smith, Kawase-Ulbrecht, Kawase-De and Bhatti-Shah. The heat-transfer coefficient follows from h = Nu*k/Di and is left to the caller.

authors: S. W. Churchill and S. C. Zajic (Churchill-Zajic correlation)
M. S. Bhatti and R. K. Shah (Bhatti-Shah correlation)
F. W. Dittus and L. M. K. Boelter (Dittus-Boelter correlation)
E. N. Sieder and G. E. Tate (Sieder-Tate correlation)
origin.notes: ht 1.2.0, commit 85e0ee6 (2025-12-07), file ht/conv_internal.py, MIT license, Copyright (C) 2016 Caleb Bell. The scientific basis of each correlation is the original paper or book cited in its function comment block (in most cases as given in Rohsenow, Hartnett & Cho, Handbook of Heat Transfer, 3E, McGraw-Hill, 1998). Translation published under the CoolSolve_Library MIT license (decision D3).

verification.reference: doctest values of ht 1.2.0 ht/conv_internal.py (case A) and additional values computed with the same ht functions in a throw-away virtualenv (case B); 52 output values in total
verification.notes: compare_solution.py: 52 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); largest relative deviation 3.2e-13 (Nu_Churchill_Zajic_B), i.e. round-off only.
